messages:
maria (sec): Need a tiny handback template for SIEM extracts used in incident triage. Must state who unwraps KMS, TTL, ephemeral RBAC window, scrub flag, and chain-of-custody. ping @dina @jon.

dina (oncall): We did this last month. Default TTL=48h, infra runs unwrap via KMS proxy, oncall gets ephemeral role for duration, and we record ticket + audit logs.

jon (infra): Agreed. Never give direct CMK decrypt to humans. Infra automates role creation and KMS proxy unwrap. Legal holds can request up to 7d with explicit approvals.

kms-bot: KMS unwraps require ticket_id, approver, and justification. All unwraps logged to audit.kms.

maria (sec): Can someone paste a copy/paste template we can add to runbook? Minimal fields only.

eli (sre): Template (copy into ticket):

REQUEST: FOR-INC-4521 - short desc
TTL: 48h (max default)
DATASETS: auth, proxy, app-traces
PII_YN: no
KMS_UNWRAP: security-kms-proxy
EPHEMERAL_ROLE: ephemeral/forensics-FOR-INC-4521 (expires=48h)
APPROVER: sec_oncall
JUSTIFICATION: vuln triage
TICKET: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FOR-INC-4521
CHAIN_OF_CUSTODY: ticket + snapshot-id + action-log
EXPORT_POLICY: no external transfer; internal presigned URL expiry=1h
SCRUB: auth-pii-minimize (if PII_YN=yes)

maria (sec): Perfect. Sam: legal ok with PII flag and 7d exception process?

sam (legal): Yes. If PII_YN=yes require scrub-first or explicit legal sign-off. TTL>48h requires product + legal approval recorded in ticket (max 7d).

dina (oncall): I'll add this to the runbook and include the infra commands to create snapshots and ephemeral roles.

maria (sec): Thanks all :thumbsup:
